As the 2026 World Cup draws to a close, Major League Soccer (MLS) will return to Apple TV tomorrow, with a series of related features launching simultaneously across multiple platforms including Apple Maps, Apple Sports, and Apple Fitness+. Details are as follows.

MLS Returns to Apple TV

Apple today is highlighting the return of Apple League Soccer, with six matches scheduled over the coming days:

July 17 (Thursday):

  • CF Montréal vs Toronto FC (7:30 PM ET)
  • Chicago Fire FC vs Vancouver Whitecaps FC (8:30 PM ET)
  • St. Louis City SC vs Sporting Kansas City (8:30 PM ET)
  • Seattle Sounders FC vs Portland Timbers (10:30 PM ET)

July 18 (Friday):

  • Nashville SC vs Atlanta United FC (8:10 PM ET)
  • LA Galaxy vs LAFC (10:15 PM ET)

To mark the return of the regular season, Apple has announced a series of MLS-themed features across its platforms, including a brand-new "Time to Walk" audio experience for Apple Fitness+ subscribers.

The latest episode features German football legend Thomas Müller as a guest, who "reflects on the efforts made before achieving fame and shares why he embraces the challenges of major life transitions."

Apple Music will also launch multiple exclusive playlists personally curated by star players, including Diego Luna of Real Salt Lake and Evander Da Silva Fernandes of FC Cincinnati, along with themed playlists from Eastern and Western Conference clubs such as the New York Red Bulls, New York City FC, and Orlando City SC.

On Apple Maps, Apple will introduce "matchday guides" produced by MLS clubs, as well as city tours personally curated by players, helping fans discover restaurants and local attractions near stadiums, and providing detailed venue information.

Users of the Apple Sports app can stay up to date with the latest league developments, including real-time scores, standings, live text commentary, lineups, and team statistics.

Apple concluded:

MLS matches are available at no additional cost to Apple TV subscribers in over 100 countries and regions worldwide; Apple will also provide exclusive content and access to cup competitions and playoffs throughout the season.

For more of Apple's coverage of the MLS return, please visit this link.

Apple TV is available for $12.99 per month, or through an Apple One subscription bundle. The platform offers a range of popular series and films, including Severance, The Studio, The Morning Show, Shrinking, and Silo.
